sections.title: Return of income.
sections.text: Where the total income of a registered non-profit organisation, without giving effect to the provisions of this Part, exceeds the maximum amount which is not chargeable to income-tax in any tax year, it shall furnish the return of income for that tax year as per the provisions of section 263(1)(a)(iii)

footnotes.text: Ins. by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-4-2026.
